key_features: QUALITY COMMITMENT - Enjoy the peace of mind that comes with our 3-Year Assurance. This backpack is backed by our guarantee, which includes free repairs or a replacement if you ever face any issues. We are dedicated to ensuring your satisfaction and the longevity of your product.

LARGE CAPACITY (12L,15*11.5*5) - Mibasies kids backpack for girls and boys has a spacious space. The front pocket is designed with insulating material, so it can put down snacks or lunch and easily keep food fresh and clean, It is also convenient to wipe even if it gets dirty. The main pocket can be used to store large items, including books and clothes, folders. The side pocket is used to store water cups, umbrellas and other items.

HARD-WEARING MATERIAL - The kids boy and girls backpack is made of hard-wearing polyester fabric. In addition to being water-resistant, all stitching is reinforced to ensure tear-resistance of the pack. The zipper we use is the YKK zipper, which is very smooth to use, which solves the problem that the zipper is too stuck for little kids to open.

LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN - Boys and girls backpack sized backpacks are perfect for kindergarten elementary or kids going to school. The thickened and decompressed shoulder straps can reduce the pressure on the shoulders and keep the backpack from being too heavy, which is a kind of protection for children. There is also a handle on the top of the backpack, which allows the bag to be carried by hand or carried on the back.

IDEAL GIFT - The main pocket has a brand name to write down your little kids name, the back is designed with a breathable sponge that can be breathable to prevent sweating from the corners of the clothes. There is also a detailed whistle design that can be used as a toy or as an alarm whistle. This brightly colored and patterned backpack is the perfect gift for your lovely little kids.
